message.content:
This editorial illustration features a caricature of a man from the chest up against a green background with a red vertical border on the left. The man has a broad face with deep-set lines, a wide, toothy grin, and short dark hair. He wears a dark olive-green military-style jacket with golden shoulder epaulettes featuring four-pointed star symbols. A white collared shirt and a dark green tie are visible underneath. In his right hand, which is held up, he grasps a golden, cylindrical baton decorated with a row of five-pointed stars. His skin is rendered in shades of tan and orange with pronounced highlights.

White and black text is layered over the image. At the top, white text reads "SIAPA MEMBEBASKAN SUDJIONO TIMAN / BEREBUT KUASA DI SKK MIGAS." Below that, the large white word "TEMPO" is centered. Smaller white text to the right says "EDISI 2-8 SEPTEMBER 2013." On the left, smaller white text says "Mengantongi Rp 36 miliar, Jenderal Moeldoko mengaku pernah menerima gratifikasi." Large white text at the bottom left reads "SELAMAT DATANG PANGLIMA TAJIR." A small barcode and publication details are in the bottom right corner.
